seo.title: Contact & Booking
seo.description: Book a 15-minute introductory call with Dr Lauretta Ogbum. Online worldwide, and in-person sessions by appointment in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos.

hero.title: Let us begin with a conversation.
hero.intro: Not sure where to begin? A brief introductory call gives us an opportunity to discuss what brings you here and explore whether my services are right for you. This is an introductory conversation, not a therapy session or assessment.

form.title: Book an Introductory Call
form.intro: You do not need to have everything figured out before seeking support. A sentence or two about what brings you here is enough.
